@Gideon Sato: you first reported the kiosks offline at **10:42 AM on 3 Aug**, in #inc-vtg-hartford. Your message said both inbound lanes showed a white screen after badge scan.

In the meantime, the channel records the guard **writing trailer numbers on a clipboard** by hand, since check-in couldn't go through the kiosks. Mateo later reported kiosk 1 back at 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You posted at 11:08 AM that both lanes were working as of 11:07.
